Self-paced course provider

UPI Study

Self-paced general education, business and technology courses. ACE and NCCRS courses have separate records; neither guarantees a university award.

Research profile · confirm exact school and course acceptance

How the credit works

ACE or NCCRS recommendations for designated courses. Each course has its own recommendation, credit quantity and effective dates.

Pace and learning format

Self-paced with no fixed completion deadline. Course quizzes, assignments and a remotely proctored final are required.

Costs to check

Published plans include $99 USD per month or $599 USD one-time lifetime access for US citizens and military personnel. Individual courses generally list $250 USD; lab and bundle prices vary.

Check the current checkout terms and the costs that apply to your actual course list. Membership time, assessments, materials, retakes, transcripts, and school fees may need separate attention.

Assessments and requirements

Online quizzes and assignments lead to a proctored final. Completion and transcript records must match the exact ACE or NCCRS course version.

Before you commit

  • Choose the exact receiving school, degree, and catalog year.
  • Confirm this specific course, recommendation or transcript source—not only the provider’s name.
  • Ask which requirement the learning will satisfy and check duplicate-credit, grade, date, and source limits.
  • Keep a written school decision before paying for an outside course you need for graduation.
